node.statement: For eta small enough that ||X^2-I||_{inf->inf}<1, define (X^2)^(-1/2) by the convergent binomial series and theta(X)=(I+X(X^2)^(-1/2))/2. The series commutes with X, fixes 1, and satisfies ||(X^2)^(-1/2)-I||_{inf->inf} <= K eta for a universal K; hence S=X(X^2)^(-1/2) has S^2=I, S1=1, and ||S-X||_{inf->inf} <= C eta.
